_doc: THE PARITY REGISTRY — see scripts/check-parity.mjs. Every member-facing write is tool | gap (ladder rung 1 private write, 2 member-sent draft, 3 confirm card) | exempt (why). npm run check:parity -- --list prints the open ladder.

assistantApi:askAssistant.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

assistantConsentApi:setConsent.exempt: the assistant never flips its own consent (doctrine — the person taps)

assistantConsentApi:syncAssistantConsent.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

assistantFeedApi:markThreadRead.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

assistantFeedApi:postToAssistantFeed.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

assistantFeedApi:postAssistantHandoff.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

practiceApi:importPracticePayments.exempt: practice ledger of a provider's own clients — clinical-adjacent; assistant access waits on the founder's consent call (BUSINESS honesty rule 6)

practiceApi:savePracticeInfo.exempt: practice ledger — same consent hold as importPracticePayments

practiceApi:savePracticeClient.exempt: client key holds client names — no assistant path until the founder decides

bookingApi:guestCreateBooking.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

bookingApi:guestRescheduleBooking.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

bookingApi:guestCancelBooking.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

bookingApi:sendBookingMail.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

bookingApi:startBookingCheckout.note: money — confirm card + Always allow within ⚡100/⚡300, >⚡500 waits 24h

bookingApi:requestCashout.note: money — confirm card + Always allow within ⚡100/⚡300, >⚡500 waits 24h

bookingApi:cancelCashout.note: money — confirm card + Always allow within ⚡100/⚡300, >⚡500 waits 24h

calendarApi:createEvent.tool: draft_event (Compose creates it on the member's Post)

calendarApi:syncExternalCalendars.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

calendarApi:startGoogleConnect.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

chatApi:markChatRead.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

chatApi:ensureSpaceChat.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

chatApi:ensureSuggestionChat.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

chatApi:ensureDirectChat.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

chatApi:ensureSelfChat.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

chatApi:ensureHelpChat.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

conciergeApi:tuneWowWindow.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

driveFilesApi:uploadDriveFile.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

eventGuestsApi:requestEventSpot.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

eventGuestsApi:guestRsvp.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

ledgerApi:startLoadCheckout.note: money — confirm card + Always allow within ⚡100/⚡300, >⚡500 waits 24h

notificationsApi:markNotificationRead.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

notificationsApi:markScopeReadRemote.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

postGuestsApi:requestPurchase.note: money — confirm card + Always allow within ⚡100/⚡300, >⚡500 waits 24h

postGuestsApi:cancelPurchase.note: money — confirm card + Always allow within ⚡100/⚡300, >⚡500 waits 24h

postGuestsApi:startPostCheckout.note: money — confirm card + Always allow within ⚡100/⚡300, >⚡500 waits 24h

postsApi:createPost.tool: draft_post, draft_event (published by the member's tap)

promptsApi:markPrompt.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

videoApi:uploadVideo.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

assistantAllowanceApi:confirmProposal.exempt: the person's own tap on a confirm card — never the assistant's

assistantAllowanceApi:cancelProposal.exempt: the person's own tap on a confirm card

assistantAllowanceApi:revokeAllowance.exempt: the assistant never edits its own permissions (doctrine)

moneySafeguardsApi:loadMoneySafeguards.exempt: read-only RPC (the coach reads the same via my_money_activity)

moneySafeguardsApi:saveMoneySafeguards.tool: set_money_floor (confirm card, never Always allow); pacing switch is the member's own off-switch, like AI consent

calendarApi:myTimezone.exempt: a read of the member's own zone, not an act

eventGuestsApi:markGuestOpened.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

eventGuestsApi:loadGuestMessages.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

eventGuestsApi:loadGuestMeetingUrl.exempt: plumbing / guest-token page / pipeline, not a member act

calendarApi:syncDraftHold.exempt: Plumbing of Compose's draft autosave — the hold follows the post_drafts row; draft_event writes the draft, and the hold is minted when the member opens it.

pollApi:createPollOptions.tool: draft_event poll_times (Compose writes the options on the member's Post)

pollApi:guestPoll.exempt: Off-Lichen guest page read by invitation token — no member, no assistant.

pollApi:guestPollVote.exempt: Off-Lichen guest voting by invitation token — no member, no assistant.

calendarApi:carryDraftZoom.exempt: Plumbing inside Compose's Post — moves the draft's Zoom room to the live event; not a member-facing act of its own.

eventGuestsApi:joinEventByLink.exempt: A member coming to an event through its shareable link — the person's own tap on the guest page.

mailApi:listMailAccounts.exempt: read-only list of the member's connected inboxes
